release_notes:
TypeScript / JavaScript language server package 0.1.0

Includes typescript-language-server 5.3.0 and TypeScript 6.0.3, prepared together with their license notices. Requires an existing Node.js >=20; runtime qualification used Node.js 22.19.0 on Linux x86_64, macOS ARM64 and macOS Intel. No npm install or lifecycle scripts run in Cadencr.

Minimum Cadencr application version: 0.16.1. This release publishes package assets only. Production marketplace catalog admission and the LSP revocation feed remain held for the application 0.16.1 rollout. Managed client install/update/remove/revocation and minimum macOS 12 certification remain separate rollout checks.

Qualified archives: SHA-256 295472a5ede14af100e3a0fb0eb121d71d2818ee05399ffb3dac3290b0ec7286 (5,014,231 bytes each). Runtime qualification: https://github.com/merkr-software/cadencr-registry-qa/actions/runs/41727012894
